name: Tokyo Midtown Yaesu Conference
address: Tokyo 104-0028 Tokyo Midtown Yaesu, Yaesu Central Tower 4F and 5F, 2-2-1 Yaesu, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
accessSummary: Directly connected underground to JR Tokyo Station (via Yaesu Underground Mall) / Directly connected underground to Tokyo Station on the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line (via Yaesu Underground Mall) / 3 min walk from Kyobashi Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza Line) / 6 min walk from Nihombashi Station (Tokyo Metro Tozai Line and Ginza Line, Toei Asakusa Line)
hours: 9:00-21:00 (weekdays, Sat, Sun & holidays. Closed during the year-end and New Year holidays and on temporary equipment inspection days. Phone reception is weekdays 9:00-17:00)

rooms.name: 4F Main Conference Room 1+2
rooms.note: The two rooms can be divided and used together in a linked way, such as a seminar and a networking reception. Island layout is 120 people in the vertical layout. The layout drawings for the horizontal layout show theater 385 seats, classroom 243 seats and island 126 seats, which differ from the 378 and 240 people in the price list. The official page says "up to 378 guests when the two rooms are combined".

rooms.name: 4F Panorama Room
rooms.note: Opened on December 1, 2025. Dual-aspect windows overlooking Tokyo Station. Located opposite the main conference rooms, it can be used together with them as a sub-venue or networking space.

rooms.name: 5F Event Space
rooms.note: Classroom is 88 seats in the vertical layout (70 seats in the horizontal layout). A space suited to exhibitions and networking events.

rooms.name: 5F Studio
rooms.note: Streaming studio. When used together with the Event Space, the official figures are an area of 199+93㎡, classroom 88+36 seats and theater 140+50 seats. When used as an open space, a separate setup fee may apply.

ops.prevDaySetup: A setup day gets a 20% discount on the room fee (one day per event, 9:00-21:00). Reserve time that includes setup, rehearsal, the event itself and teardown. Business hours are 9:00-21:00. For the Main Conference Rooms, Panorama Room, Event Space and Studio, the requested layout is set up in advance free of charge (notify the layout by 2 weeks before the usage date; changing the layout during the event costs extra). For advance delivery of packages, specify an arrival date from 3 business days before the usage date up to the weekday before it; the venue holds, free of charge, what fits on a roll box pallet. (Source: User Guide and Terms of Service (Ver. 2026/09/11 onward))
ops.loadingHours: For vehicle load-in and load-out, apply in advance and use the loading dock on B2F and the in-building logistics center. Acceptance is weekdays 7:00-20:00 (last entry 19:30) and Sat, Sun & holidays 7:00-18:00 (last entry 17:30). Submit the "Load-in/Load-out Application" and the "Work Application (web)" by 2 weeks before the usage date. The freight elevator (B2F to 5F) has a capacity of 1,600 kg; the door is 1,250 mm wide x 2,500 mm high and the car is 1,400 mm wide x 2,500 mm deep x 2,800 mm high. The venue lends up to 2 hand carts free of charge; for 3 or more, the logistics center charges 150 yen (tax included) per 30 minutes. Separate protective covering and work fees may apply for 3 or more 2-ton trucks, occupying the elevator for 1 hour or more, long items of 2 m or more, single pieces over 200 kg and the like. Hand-carried luggage can use the general elevators without an application. (Source: User Guide and Terms of Service (Ver. 2026/09/11 onward))
ops.vehicleRules: Vehicle limits at the loading dock are under 3,300 mm high, under 2,300 mm wide and under 6,500 mm long. Take a parking ticket, enter the B2F loading dock, and park where the logistics center directs. Display the "Load-in/Load-out Permit" on the windshield. When leaving, in exchange for returning the security card, the parking ticket is stamped for 25 minutes free of charge (30 minutes at the Disaster Prevention Center outside the logistics center's acceptance hours). Entry and exit are left turn in, left turn out only. Carrying catering by hand cart also requires use of the loading dock. (Source: User Guide and Terms of Service (Ver. 2026/09/11 onward))
ops.parking: This is the building's general parking lot (mechanical), used also by visitors to the commercial facilities, not one dedicated to the conference. It is available 24 hours and the fee is 300 yen per 30 minutes with no maximum. Vehicles cannot enter or exit on closed days. Vehicle sizes: Unit 1 takes standard cars (length 5,600 x width 2,050 x height 1,550 mm) and mid-roof cars (height 1,850 mm), and Unit 2 takes high-roof cars (height 2,000 mm). From the B3F parking lot, take the elevator up to 4F and 5F. For chartered buses, there is an elevator going directly to 4F and 5F from the Bus Terminal Tokyo Yaesu on B2F (bus applications are separate from the conference). (Source: User Guide and Terms of Service (Ver. 2026/09/11 onward))
ops.waitingRooms: There are Waiting Room A and Waiting Room B on 4F, and Waiting Room 1 and Waiting Room 2 on 5F. Waiting Rooms A and B for the 4F Main Conference Rooms are included in the room fee; Waiting Room A has a desk (2,100 x 900 mm) and 6 chairs, Waiting Room B has a desk (1,500 x 900 mm) and 4 chairs, and each room has a full-length mirror and a coat hanger. The foyer can also be used as a reception area, and there is a cloakroom on 4F. (Source: Main Conference Rooms Equipment List with Photos, User Guide and Terms of Service (Ver. 2026/09/11 onward))
ops.catering: Food and drink are allowed inside the meeting rooms. For boxed meals and parties, choose from the caterers designated by the facility; the quotation, ordering and payment are handled directly between the user and the caterer (caterers outside the partnership cannot be used, for hygiene management). Partners include Imperial Hotel, Hotel Okura Enterprise, Keio Plaza Hotel, Nadaman, Kiyoken, Happo-en and Chikaba Kitchen Tokyo Yaesu. If you hold a reception or party after the event, a space reservation separate from the main venue is required. Mineral water (410 ml) is available at the venue for 150 yen; order it by 1 week before the usage date. Up to 7 trash bags of 45 L are free of charge; from the 8th bag, 2,000 yen per bag. Open flames and gas stoves are prohibited in the pantry. (Source: User Guide and Terms of Service (Ver. 2026/09/11 onward), Catering Partner List)
ops.restaurants: Restaurants are on floors 1 to 3 of Tokyo Midtown Yaesu, open 11:00-23:00. There is a cafe next to the exchange lounge on 5F.
